corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez causative infinitive of ቦአ ('to bring in') is አብዎቶ (Mark 2:4: ወሶበ ስዕኑ አብዎቶ ኀቤሁ); the 7th-order ዎ was misread as ዮ.
The patristic/variant Ge'ez citation reads 'ወጽፉቅ ዐዋፄ ቤታ' (the courtyard/enclosure of the house was crowded); initial ዐ was misread as በ.
The conjunction ወ at the end of line 29 is a prefix that wraps directly onto አእኰትዎ on line 30 (ወአእኰትዎ).
Canonical Ge'ez Mark 2:13 'መንገለ ጽንፈ ባሕር' ('toward the seashore'); the glyph ጽ was misread as ድ due to ink bleed.
